links.outcome: USMLE question accuracy and confabulation with versus without semantic knowledge grounding (SCAI)
links.effect: Across 313 items, accuracy rose from 90.7% to 97.1% (Gemini), 82.4% to 92.0% (Llama 3 70B), 55.3% to 81.8% (DeepSeek-R1-Distill); Copilot 93.6% to 94.2%, not significant.
links.quote: Across 313 items, accuracy increased from 90.7% to 97.1% for Gemini, 82.4% to 92.0% for Llama 3 70B, and 55.3% to 81.8% for DeepSeek-R1-Distill; Copilot changed from 93.6% to 94.2%.

screen.practice: knowledge graph retrieval grounding added to existing LLMs
screen.reason: Evaluates the addition of semantic clinical knowledge augmentation (SCAI, a knowledge graph/retrieval grounding layer) to existing commercial and open-source LLMs compared to baseline performance on USMLE exam questions.

primary.practice: retrieval grounding added to an existing tool
